# Topology and Dependence Obligations

This ledger prevents the independent ultraviolet benchmark from being
silently promoted to a full-measure statement.

| Sector or dependence | Present in Stage 09 benchmark? | Required next evidence |
|---|---|---|
| shared links between plaquettes | no | conditional or polymer activity bound for the link measure |
| nonabelian Bianchi constraints | no | compatible local constraint parametrization and Jacobian bounds |
| correlations between neighboring blocks | replaced by independence | domination or direct connected-activity estimate |
| link Haar density | yes, locally in the action norm | global chart/atlas treatment on exceptional fields |
| Coulomb-slice/Faddeev--Popov density | no | orbit disintegration with determinant and overlap bounds |
| residual constant conjugation | identified only | quotient-volume normalization and observable transport |
| boundary holonomy | no | uniform conditional estimates for every admitted boundary field |
| center flux and twisted sectors | no | sector decomposition and activity estimates |
| torons/global flat connections | no | atlas or separate sector treatment |
| instanton-like/topological charge sectors | no | cutoff- and volume-uniform weights and tunneling control |
| thermodynamic limit | no | constants uniform in volume and boundary conditions |
| repeated blocking | no | summable scale-indexed errors and stable activity norm |
| reflection positivity | not transported here | regulator/RG compatibility theorem |
| observable reconstruction | no | gauge-invariant local observable core and density theorem |

## Gauge-invariant exceptional event

The natural next event is not a link-coordinate bound.  It is a
gauge-invariant curvature and orbit-atlas failure event, for example

```text
B_X = {some plaquette in X leaves the chosen curvature chart}
      union {the local orbit cannot be represented in an admitted slice}
      union {X carries declared center/topological data}.
```

Different causes must remain labeled because their activities and blocking
rules differ.

## Stop condition

Until the complete link measure supplies a volume-uniform weighted connected
activity bound, the result remains local/restricted.  A small standalone
heat-kernel probability, a finite-volume event probability, or a numerical
Monte Carlo frequency does not close this obligation.
